title: Doesn't work with external trackpad
body:
I like how simple the util is and how fast it works.

Although, it seems like it only detects swipes from the built-in trackpad on a MacBook, the external one is ignored.
author: gim-

comments.body: Yeah this is due to the fact that I am using the MTTouch api and only registering events for a single device. working on switching to a cgevent based system or somehow listening to multiple devices
@gim-  try the latest commit. make sure aerospace-swipe is fully uninstalled before and then make install and it will prompt you to give permission and then it should work just fine.
@acsandmann I can confirm that it works now. Thank you! :)

satisfaction_conditions: Support for external trackpad devices on MacBook
Clear installation instructions for the updated version

title: detect aerospace path
author: acsandmann

comments.body: That works beautifully but for some reason not when I have it installed using "make install", idk if it is because it isnt running afterwards or smth.

@FormalSnake I think the latest commit fixed the issue with make install. When installing from the makefile it automatically adds it into launchctl and I think in that context it doesn't have access to where/which so I switched it to `command -v aerospace` and that seems to be working.

satisfaction_conditions: A solution that works when installed via 'make install'
A method to properly detect the aerospace path in different execution contexts
Compatibility with the system's launch control mechanism
